more_info.overview: Cassia gum is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, processed cheese, edible ices, heat-treated meat products. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Cassia seeds are dehusked, their germ is removed, and the endosperm is milled. The gum is further purified with propan-2-ol.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
